title: Sell Mineral Rights in Grandfalls, TX
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Grandfalls, TX | Royalty Buyer
metaDescription: Grandfalls sits along the Pecos River in Ward County's Delaware Basin acreage. A retired operations engineer explains what your interest is worth.
heroLead: Grandfalls is one of the smallest incorporated towns in Texas, but Ward County's Delaware Basin drilling has reached the ground around it all the same.
intro: With well under a hundred residents, Grandfalls is easy to overlook, but it sits in the same Ward County acreage that's seen substantial Wolfcamp and Bone Spring horizontal development over recent years. If you hold minerals here, the town's size tells you nothing about what a fair offer should look like.

sections.heading: Small town, real Ward County acreage
paragraphs: Ward County's development has spread across much of the county along the Pecos River corridor, and acreage near Grandfalls sits within reach of that activity even though the town itself has almost no infrastructure of its own.

sections.heading: Getting to a real number
paragraphs: A division order or recent check stub tells me the operator and your decimal interest directly. Without one, the section and block or a legal description lets me check production and permitting for your specific tract.

sections.heading: Family land along the river
paragraphs: Ownership around Grandfalls often traces to farming and ranching families who've worked the Pecos River corridor for generations, with mineral interests now split among heirs living well outside the area. I buy individual fractional shares directly and don't need the rest of the family involved.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: Once I have your documentation, I typically build a range within a couple of days. If you decide to move forward, most clean-title closings run three to six weeks from a signed agreement.

sections.heading: No obligation either way
paragraphs: Some Grandfalls-area owners just want to understand what an old family interest is worth before deciding anything. That's a fine reason to reach out, and I'll give you a straight number regardless of whether you sell.

faqs.question: Does Grandfalls' small size affect what my minerals are worth?
faqs.answer: No, valuation comes down to the underlying section and Ward County's development activity, not the town's population.

faqs.question: Is there active drilling happening near Grandfalls?
faqs.answer: Ward County overall has seen substantial Wolfcamp and Bone Spring activity in recent years, and acreage near Grandfalls sits within that broader development pattern.

faqs.question: I inherited this and don't have much documentation, what now?
faqs.answer: Send whatever you have, even a name from an old lease or probate file, and I'll cross-reference it against Texas Railroad Commission and county records.

faqs.question: How long does a Grandfalls-area closing usually take?
faqs.answer: Most clean-title closings run three to six weeks from a signed purchase and sale agreement, longer if there's an unresolved probate or missing heir to work through first.
